post_title: Big Tech $650B AI CapEx and Multi-Agent Orchestration Goes Enterprise

sections.title: OpenAI Frontier — Onboarding AI Agents Like New Employees
sections.lead: OpenAI Frontier is a full-stack enterprise platform that allows companies to onboard AI agents like new employees, assigning roles and permissions for management.

sections.title: Claude Opus 4.6 — Leads Agentic Coding Benchmarks with Official Parallel Multi-Agent Support
sections.lead: Claude Opus 4.6 supports parallel subtask delegation through agent teams functionality, providing 1M context and 128k output.

sections.title: Google Gemini Deep Think & GLM-5 — Eroding the "Open-Source Lags One Generation" Myth
sections.lead: Google Gemini Deep Think is a specialized reasoning mode for advanced research problems in mathematics, physics, and computer science, while GLM-5 is a 754B-parameter open-source model under an MIT license.

sections.title: Neuromorphic Vision Chip — Robot Motion Recognition 4x Faster Than Humans
sections.lead: Beihang University and the Beijing Aerospace Research Institute announced a neuromorphic vision chip that mimics the lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN) structure of the human brain.

sections.title: Big Tech $650B CAPEX — AI Infrastructure Elevated to a National-Scale Energy Project
sections.lead: Amazon ~$200B, Alphabet $175–185B, Meta $115–135B, and Microsoft ~$105B combine for a total of $650 billion in Big Tech AI infrastructure investment for 2026.

sections.title: M&A "The Great Rebound" — Devon-Coterra $21.4B, Alphabet-Wiz $30B, PANW-CyberArk $25B
sections.lead: Large M&A deals in AI and security have surged, re-igniting the M&A market.

sections.title: AAIF (Agentic AI Foundation) Launch — Agent Interoperability Standards Formalized Under Linux Foundation
sections.lead: The Agentic AI Foundation, with OpenAI, Anthropic, Block, Microsoft, AWS, and Cloudflare, launched under the Linux Foundation.

sections.title: Labor Market and the Productivity Paradox — Adaptation Period Required Before AI Benefits Distribute
sections.lead: According to TEKsystems research, companies report experiencing productivity gains from AI while simultaneously rescheduling digital transformation timelines due to increasing system complexity.
